title: Introducing Hurdle: Run agent evals on your API, skills, and docs
headline: Together AI releases Hurdle for API and docs agent evals
lede: Developers can use an open-source npm library to run Claude Code and Codex on real API, skill, and documentation tasks scored by code checks, guards, and an LLM judge.

effects.effect: Standardizes side-by-side comparisons across models and harness conditions.
Combines deterministic code checks, guards, and LLM judges for agent runs.
Makes APIs, skills, and documentation directly testable by real coding agents.
